description: Phase 6bj gate — GENERATED columns (virtual only). Column whose value is computed from an expression over the row's other columns, evaluated on every read.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a * 2) VIRTUAL);

cases.name: generated-without-always-keyword
cases.description: `GENERATED ALWAYS` is optional — `AS (expr) VIRTUAL` is sufficient.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER AS (a + 1));
CREATE TABLE t (price REAL, qty INTEGER, total REAL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (price * qty) VIRTUAL);
SELECT price, qty, total FROM t ORDER BY price;

cases.name: generated-cannot-insert-explicit
cases.description: Attempting to INSERT an explicit value into a GENERATED column is an error.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a * 2) VIRTUAL);

cases.name: generated-null-propagates
cases.description: Expression over a NULL source produces NULL.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a * 2) VIRTUAL);

cases.name: generated-update-source-reflects
cases.description: UPDATE of source column changes the computed column's visible value on next read.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a * 2) VIRTUAL);
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a * 10) VIRTUAL);
SELECT a FROM t WHERE b > 15 ORDER BY a;
